name: website-archiver
description: Archive websites by domain with snapshot diff reporting.

scripts.build:windows-cli: npm run build:windows-controller && pkg build/windows-controller.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/website-archiver-control-cli.exe
scripts.build:windows-ui: dotnet publish .\windows-ui\WebsiteArchiverControlApp\WebsiteArchiverControlApp.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true /p:PublishSingleFile=true && copy /Y .\windows-ui\WebsiteArchiverControlApp\bin\Release\net9.0-windows\win-x64\publish\WebsiteArchiverControlApp.exe .\dist\website-archiver-control.exe
scripts.build:windows-exe: npm run build:windows-cli && npm run build:windows-ui
